primitives.name: Sample Size Self-Contradiction
primitives.verbatim_quote: FINDINGS — structural (inspected + recomputed) **F-01 — Sample-size self-contradiction [CONFIRMED, exact].** 1,400 entries carry `sample_size_n` below their own family's `min_sample_size_n` as declared in the catalog header's `families[]` table.
primitives.assumptions: Each family declares a minimum sample size; entries must satisfy this constraint.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When sample size n < min_sample_size_n for a given family.

layer2.mapping: The catalog's structural integrity depends on consistent adherence to declared family constraints. Violation implies inconsistent data quality control.
layer2.telemetry: Count of entries violating family minimum sample size.

primitives.name: Generative Cycling
primitives.verbatim_quote: **F-02 — Generative cycling [CONFIRMED, exact, 12,304/12,304 on all three cycles].** For entry index i (1-based): `formula_type = F[(i-1) mod 9]`, `theorem_or_source = T[(i-1) mod 25]`, `family_id = Fam[(i-1) mod 279]`.
primitives.assumptions: Formula type, theorem label, and family ID are independently cycled through fixed sets.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When theorem label does not reflect underlying formula or family context.

layer2.mapping: The generative mechanism creates artificial correlations between formula types and theorem labels, rendering them semantically meaningless.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of entries where theorem label is independent of formula type.

primitives.name: Binding Space Tiny
primitives.verbatim_quote: **F-03 — Binding space is tiny [CONFIRMED].** Only **30 distinct parameter-binding triples** serve all 12,304 entries; the top two recur 423× each: (away_sack_rate_allowed, home_ol_starters_out, home_pressure_rate) and (precipitation_flag, temp_f, wind_mph).
primitives.assumptions: Parameter bindings should vary widely to support diverse applications.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When only 30 unique triplets suffice for 12,304 entries.

layer2.mapping: Limited parameter combinations imply poor generalization capability and lack of semantic richness in model instantiation.
layer2.telemetry: Number of distinct parameter-binding triples across all entries.
